name: It looks like only the pumpkins are U-pick,
description: It looks like only the pumpkins are U-pick, is a pumpkin patch in Camino, CA. Visitors come for Apples, Pears, Pumpkins, Corn, and Christmas trees, best in autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Aug – Nov in this growing zone.
